home.heroSubtitle: Clean silhouettes, soft blue tones, and clothing for a calm confident rhythm.
home.aboutBody: NewEra releases its own collections with a focus on fit, texture, and precise details. This is not a marketplace: every product belongs to the brand and follows one visual and quality standard.
home.deliveryNote: Payment in the next stages will be manual only through the brand QR code.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Filter the collection by size, color, price, gender, and product state.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.subtitle: Enter delivery details. After the order is created, you will see the QR code for manual payment.
checkout.qrOnlyText: NewEra does not use Alif, Stripe, PayPal, or any other payment systems. Payment is accepted only through the brand QR code.
checkout.name: Name

errors.products: One product is unavailable or the quantity exceeds stock.

orders.title: Purchases
orders.empty: You do not have orders yet.
orders.qrText: Scan the QR code from assets and pay manually. If you do not press “I paid”, the order stays unpaid.
orders.markedPaid: Payment is marked. The order is waiting for confirmation.
orders.contactAfterPayment: After payment, please contact us to confirm the order.

auth.loginHeroTitle: Your NewEra wardrobe, kept in one account.

auth.registerHeroText: Keep your future orders and manual payment confirmations connected to one profile.

footer.brandText: NewEra is an owned clothing brand. Minimal design, premium fit, and manual order confirmation.
